summary: Just got so annoyed I could not find A, agreed upon standards for metadata in #OER, B, the curation tools did not expose their backend (while claiming open mantra) and C too many people hopping on complicated apps or front end design frameworks rather than HTML first.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Just got so annoyed I could not find A, agreed upon standards for metadata in #OER, B, the curation tools did not expose their backend (while claiming open mantra) and C too many people hopping on complicated apps or front end design frameworks rather than HTML first.
